title: Scroll Velocity Skew
description: Danh sách thẻ cuộn nhanh thì các thẻ nghiêng theo hướng cuộn (tối đa 9°), dừng lại là thẳng ngay.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio velocity-skew, written here): Viewport 160x158; cards 128x50 r8 every 62 px. List scrolls 0 → 190 px (0.3-0.85 s power2.inOut), holds, returns 1.6-2.15 s. Each card skewY (around its centre) = clamp(speed px/s × 0.012, −9°, +9°), smoothed by a spring k520 c30 so it is back at 0° about 180 ms after the scroll stops. Only small surfaces lean. Params: scroll (190 px) · factor (0.012 °/(px/s)) · max (9°) · spring (k520 c30).
